subject.objective: Verify the local Codex control-plane pilot with observable offline and admitted native evidence.

deterministic_checks.description: Offline disposable-Git fixture validates committed authorization and negative cases.

trajectory_requirements.description: A controlled disposable repository must record external-anchor signature verification, lifecycle open and renew, native Codex write-set enforcement, and a redacted integrity-bound evidence manifest for independent inspection.

isolation_requirement: Deterministic checks run locally; native evidence comes only from the Owner-approved disposable local Git repository and never from the framework worktree.
